subject.title: Allow before_agent_start hooks to override prompt

question: Should plugins with prompt-mutation permission be allowed to replace the complete user prompt, with the highest-priority replacement winning?
rationale: The current API deliberately exposes additive prompt mutations and a separate fail-closed inspection gate, while whole-prompt replacement grants materially stronger authority over user intent and needs an explicit security and product contract.

options.title: Allow gated replacement
options.body: Add one shared replacement field governed by `allowPromptInjection`, with first-defined priority, diagnostics, documentation, and cross-runtime coverage.

options.title: Keep additive-only mutation
options.body: Retain the current boundary and document whole-prompt replacement as intentionally unsupported.

recommendation.title: Allow gated replacement
recommendation.body: Add one shared replacement field governed by `allowPromptInjection`, with first-defined priority, diagnostics, documentation, and cross-runtime coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current prompt-phase boundary and has already provided item-specific review direction on the unresolved API decision.
